result.brief: 提出基于预训练视频 Diffusion Transformer 的高保真视频虚拟试穿框架，通过时间步自适应调制与帧对齐位置编码增强服装-视频细粒度对应，提升高分辨率下的细节保持与时序一致性。
result.reason: Video virtual try-on built on a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer with timestep-adaptive garment conditioning and frame-aligned positional encoding; directly advances controllable video generation and cross-modal conditioning.
